items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: He was around the same time as... Fess Williams. Do you know Fess Williams?

ctx.x: Band. He was a very big guy who played alto saxophone. And in the days before I got there, he had been pretty big guy, you know. He was around the same time as...oh, I'm trying to think of his name... Fess Williams. Do you know Fess Williams?
